destination_poi.description_summer:
Piz Languard, a popular viewpoint, is well accessible on a path from Pontresina. Until high up, the southern and western faces consist of pastures, while the summit structure does not begin before an altitude of ca. 2900 m. Its eastern face falls steeply down to Val Prüna. Three ridges merge on the summit. The eastern ridge is the wildest. Piz Languard is most impressive when viewed from the east. 
W. Rey in 1846

neighbor_summits.description: This beautiful viewpoint is part of Muottas da Puntraschigna and is located vis-à-vis Piz Languard on the other side of Val Bernina. Pontresina railway station – Punt Ota – Tais – P. 2245 (marked white-red-white until here). Continue south-westward on a faint path, then pathless to Muot d’Mez. Descend on the ascent to P. 2245, then turn right and make an arc back to Pontresina. 2 h on the ascent, 1¾ h on the descent, T3.
neighbor_summits.name: Muot d’Mez

reference_poi.description_summer: Die Muottas da Puntraschigna bilden die nördliche Verlängerung des Piz Chalchagn. Einer der drei auf der Karte kotierten Punkte heisst Muot d'Mez.

photos.caption: Ascending to Piz Languard: view towards Moritz
Shortly before the summit, below is Georgys Hütte and behind the Bernina range.

segments.description: From Alp Languard ascend the marked and signposted trail eastward through Val Languard, passing several bifurcations (signposts). Traversing Plaun da l’Esen and turning left at the bifurcation at P. 2822, you reach P. 2926 below the south face of Piz Languard. On the south-face zig-zag steeply up to Georgys Hütte at ca. 3180 m. The continuation is even steeper. The face narrows to a ridge, where the trail is equipped with steel cables. Some scrambling is required and overcoming a short, exposed passage is needed before reaching the triangulation signal on the summit.
segments.title: Alp Languard – Piz Languard

segments.description: On the ascent descend to Georgys Hütte. Continue, still on the ascent route, to the foot of the south face (P. 2926) and the bifurcation at P. 2822. Instead of continuing on the ascent, now turn left, descend to P. 2485 in Val Languard and ascend a short while to reach Chamanna Paradis. On a ridge with a view continue to P. 2434. Traversing to the other side of the valley, descend back to Alp Languard and the chair-lift.
segments.title: Piz Languard – Chamanna Paradis – Alp Languard

segments.description: From the Punt Muragl railway station go 5 min to the bottom station of the Muottas Muragl funicular. From the summit station ascend to Chamanna Segantini and follow the so-called «Steinbockweg (ibex trail)» above Val Languard until Plaun da l’Esen (P. 2732), where you meet the main route. Muottas Muragl – Piz Languard 4½ h, marked white-red-white, T4–.
segments.title: Variant: ascent from Muottas Muragl

teaser: The easy accessibility of the summit and the cabin high up cannot hide the fact that the trail is steep, stony and at times exposed. Thanks to Georgys Hütte it is uncomplicated to experience sunrise and sunset surrounded by majestic mountains. Observing ibex is almost guaranteed.
teaser_title: In the realm of the ibex
title: South-west face
